plain.li: [land:desert] A jar of sand stands on the table this morning, scooped by {A_nameDef} from where the first tent stood. That's how founding day begins here now.
[land:tundra] {A_nameDef} has been telling the newer people about the first night here, when it was colder than this and three of them shared one blanket.
[land:coast] {A_nameDef} walked down to the shore and back before breakfast, the way the first of the colony walked it on their first morning here.
[land:forest|land:boreal] A strip of cloth is tied round the stump of the first tree the colony felled. {A_nameDef} put it there at dawn, for founding day.
[land:mountains|land:hills] {A_nameDef} climbed to the high ledge above the colony at sunrise and waved down until someone waved back.
[land:swamp|land:jungle] Founding day in the damp. {A_nameDef} says the insects kept the founders awake all that first night, and scratches an old bite while {A_pronoun} tells it.
[land:river] At dawn {A_nameDef} set a little bark boat on the river, the way the colony counts its years.
[faith] {A_nameDef} gave thanks at first light for the colony and the people in it, and hopes the day will be kept well.
[devout] {A_nameDef} spent the dawn praying for the ones who founded this place, the living and the dead.
[land:desert] Every green thing in the {PLACE} is hard won. {A_nameDef} wants the first sheaf of the harvest on the table, where it can be seen.
[land:tundra] In land this cold, any harvest is worth a day of its own. {A_nameDef} has been saying so since breakfast.
[land:jungle|land:swamp] {A_nameDef} has hung the first of the crop up high, out of the damp, where everyone who passes can see it.
[land:river] A handful of grain went into the river this morning. {A_nameDef} says the river watered the colony's first crop, and it's only fair.
[devout] {A_nameDef} set aside the first of the grain as an offering before anyone was allowed to eat.
[land:desert] Snow, in the {PLACE}. {A_nameDef} is out in it with both hands held up, laughing.
[land:tundra|land:boreal] First snow, and in this country that means months of it. {A_nameDef} has the games ready all the same.
[land:mountains] The peaks went white days ago, and overnight the snow finally came down to the colony. {A_nameDef} was up early to see it.
[land:coast|land:lake] It's {NAME}, and {A_nameDef} wants the feast down by the water, with whatever the water gave this week.
[land:desert] The tables for {NAME} are set in the shade, with a water jar at every place. {A_nameDef} saw to it before the heat came up.
[faith] Before the feast for {NAME}, {A_nameDef} will say the faith's blessing over the food.
[devout] For {NAME}, {A_nameDef} has been praying since dawn, naming each of the colony's dead in turn.
[faith] {A_nameDef} will say the faith's words for the dead this evening, for {NAME}.
[land:tundra|land:boreal] {A_nameDef} lit a fire by the graves at dawn for {NAME}, the way it's done where the winters are long.
[land:desert] {A_nameDef} poured water into the sand at dawn for the ones remembered on {NAME}, a mouthful at each grave.
[devout] {A_nameDef} has kept a lamp burning since dawn for {DEAD}, who died on this day, and prays beside it between chores.
[faith] This evening {A_nameDef} will say the faith's words at {DEAD}'s grave, on the day {DEAD} died.
[land:desert] Water is scarce in the {PLACE}, and {A_nameDef} poured a full cup of it on {DEAD}'s grave this morning.
[land:coast] {A_nameDef} went down to the shore at dawn and left a smooth stone above the tideline for {DEAD}, who died on this day.
[land:desert] Walked out to where the first tent stood. The sand has covered every trace of it.
[land:coast] Down to the shore at dawn. Wet boots all day, worth it.
[land:mountains|land:hills] Climbed up above the colony this morning. From up there it looks small, and like it belongs.
[land:tundra] Founding day. Another year the cold didn't win.
[devout] Gave thanks for every year we've had here, and asked for one more.
[!new,land:desert] Harvest day. I hauled water for every one of those rows, all summer.
[!new,land:tundra|land:boreal] Short summer, and we still got a harvest in.
[!new,devout] First grain set aside as an offering, the rest to the table.
[devout] I lit a lamp for {DEAD} today. I believe {DEAD} is kept, wherever that is.
[faith] Said the faith's words at {DEAD}'s grave. My voice held up until the last line.
[devout] Prayed for our dead today, for {NAME}. I felt they heard.
[land:tundra|land:boreal] Kept the fire going by the graves all day for {NAME}. We took turns fetching wood.
[land:coast] {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} talked about the colony's first morning on the coast.
[land:desert] {A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} how the colony found its first water in the {PLACE}.
[land:forest|land:boreal] {A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} which stump was the first tree the colony ever felled.
[land:river] {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} argued over where on the river the colony first drew water.
[devout] {A_nameDef} told {B_nameDef} the prayer {A_pronoun} says for the dead on {NAME}.
[faith] {A_nameDef} asked {B_nameDef} what the faith says becomes of the dead.
